result.title: FPD-Drive: Future Policy Distillation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
result.summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on real-world driving logs, which record only the trajectory actually executed in each scene. This provides limited supervision for learning alternative valid behaviors. Multi-target supervision can mitigate this limitation, but broader trajectory coverage makes safe candidate selection more challenging. We propose FPD-Drive, an end-to-end planner that distills privileged future knowledge into a visual driving policy to improve both multi-trajectory supervision and safety selection. Specifically, we introduce Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation to transfer diverse, high-quality trajectory targets from a teacher with access to recorded future observations to the student. These targets extend supervision beyond the single recorded human trajectory. For candidate selection, we further introduce Safety-Aware Score Correction to correct ranking errors between nearby safe and unsafe candidates and raise underestimated safety scores of safe candidates. At deployment, the student requires neither future observations nor teacher inference. Our base model achieves 94.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest and 55.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navhard. The scaled FPD-Drive-Pro improves these scores to 95.5 PDMS and 58.1 EPDMS, respectively, achieving SOTA performance among the compared methods on both benchmarks. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further yields an HD-Score of 45.1 and RC of 55.3.

AI.brief_summary: 提出端到端自动驾驶规划器 FPD-Drive，用「未来特权多目标蒸馏」把可获取未来观测的教师的多条高质量轨迹监督迁移到只依赖视觉的学生策略，并以安全感知得分校正改善候选轨迹的排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「特权信息蒸馏＋多目标监督＋候选重排校正」线索可供核查是否对应 LVR 中 latent 状态的监督信号设计、贡献分配与答案/证据筛选，但属跨领域迁移推测，需人工判断可借鉴性。
